## Release dates (checked 2026-10-21)

- https://breezewiki.com/finalfantasy/wiki/Final_Fantasy_XV:_War_for_Eos (read by me through the Fandom API): developer and publisher Machine Zone, licensing the name from Square Enix; release ID, MY, PH March 21, 2022 (Android "early access") and ROW February 16, 2023 ("based on press releases and the presence of advertising"); end October 8, 2024, due to declining interest; Android and iOS
  - The entry's date stays 2022-03-21 (user, 2026-10-21): the "early access" ran in three countries for about eleven months with real players, so it is a limited release that counts (kit docs/data.md, "Limited releases count"), not a soft launch; the worldwide release was 2023-02-16

## Decisions
- Date is 2022-03-21, the Indonesia, Malaysia and Philippines limited release, not the worldwide 2023-02-16 (user, 2026-10-21)
- `helpWanted` removed (user, 2026-10-21)
